steps.action:
# Click the "Table" menu in LibreOffice Writer’s top menu bar to open its dropdown
pyautogui.click(x=420, y=72, duration=0.5)

# Click the "Insert Table..." option (first item) in the open Table menu to open the Insert Table dialog
pyautogui.click(x=310, y=87, duration=0.5)

# Click the "Table" menu in the top menu bar to show its dropdown
pyautogui.click(x=305, y=52, duration=0.5)

# Click the "Table" menu in the top menu bar to open its dropdown
pyautogui.click(x=285, y=52, duration=0.5)

# Press Ctrl+F12 to open LibreOffice Writer’s “Insert Table” dialog
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'f12')

# Click into the "Columns" value field (showing '2') in the Insert Table dialog to activate it for editing
pyautogui.click(x=589, y=282, duration=0.5)

# Click inside the "Columns" spin box (currently showing '2') to give it focus for editing
pyautogui.click(x=620, y=282, duration=0.3)

# Click inside the "Columns" numeric field (currently displaying '2') in the Insert Table dialog to set focus
pyautogui.click(x=579, y=282, duration=0.3)

# Click inside the "Columns" numeric field (showing '2') in the Insert Table dialog to give it focus for editing
pyautogui.click(x=610, y=282, duration=0.3)

# Press Tab to move focus from the "Name" field to the "Columns" numeric field in the Insert Table dialog
pyautogui.press('tab')

# Type "7" in the highlighted "Columns" field of the Insert Table dialog to set columns to 7
pyautogui.typewrite('7')

# Click inside the "Rows" numeric field (currently showing '2') in the Insert Table dialog to focus it for editing
pyautogui.click(x=780, y=282, duration=0.3)

# Type "5" in the highlighted "Rows" numeric field of the Insert Table dialog to set rows to 5
pyautogui.typewrite('5')

# Press Backspace once in the Columns field to change the value from "75" to "7"
pyautogui.press('backspace')

# Click inside the "Rows" numeric field (currently showing '2') in the Insert Table dialog to focus it for editing
pyautogui.click(x=780, y=276, duration=0.3)

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);
